statement.notes: 1) 'Short-term investments' from the primary statement is mapped to 'marketable_securities' as it is a liquid asset. 2) 'Accounts receivable' values are taken from the supplementary aging analysis table (Note 33), which provides the net figure. 3) 'Total_debt_short_term_and_long_term' includes all listed debt components: Short-term bank borrowings, Short-term unsecured senior notes, Long-term bank borrowings, Long-term unsecured senior notes, and Long-term convertible unsecured senior notes. For 2024, short-term unsecured senior notes were 16,252; for 2025, they were 0. Long-term convertible notes were 0 in 2024 and 35,834 in 2025. All values are listed as separate array elements per the rule not to add them up. 4) 'Total_equity' is taken from the 'Total equity' line in the primary statement. 5) Currency is CNY (RMB) as reported, though USD equivalents are also provided.
